name: openemr-asr-demo
description: OpenEMR voice-to-text with a local clinical NLP pipeline.

scripts.check: npm run check:js && npm run check:py && npm run check:manifest && npm run test:py
scripts.check:js: node --check extension/content.js && node --check extension/scanner.js && node --check scripts/build-extension.mjs && node --check scripts/watch-extension.mjs && node --check web/engine.js && node --check web/engine-worker.js && node --check web/demo.js
scripts.check:py: python3 -m py_compile asr/api.py asr/nlp/pipeline.py asr/nlp/medical.py asr/nlp/coding.py asr/nlp/phi.py asr/nlp/soap.py asr/nlp/asr_quality.py
scripts.site:dev: npm run build:site && npx wrangler pages dev --port 8799
scripts.site:deploy: npm run check && npm run build:site && npx wrangler pages deploy --project-name medvoice --branch main --commit-dirty=true
